name: bSlider – Build Sliders That Bring Your Content to Life
author: bPlugins

sections.description:
Create responsive sliders from images, posts, WooCommerce products, videos, or slides built out of Gutenberg blocks — or start from more than 100 ready-made templates — with multiple layouts, animations, and styling controls, right in the block editor.

Documentation | Demo | Pricing | Support

bSlider makes it easy to build engaging sliders without coding. Choose transitions like fade, slide or flip, customize titles, buttons, indicators and arrows, reorder slides by drag-and-drop, and adjust settings per device.

Use it for product showcases, portfolios, testimonials or hero sections. It works with any theme add the Gutenberg block, or place a shortcode anywhere.

Start from a ready-made design. The Template Library, opened from the block editor toolbar, has more than 92 sliders for agencies, shops, restaurants, real estate, portfolios, video and social feeds. Pick one, click Import, and change anything you like:

In bSlider Pro, describe the look you want in one sentence and Style with AI sets the slider’s colours, type, buttons and arrows. It also writes each slide’s title, description, button label and alt text from its picture, using your own Google Gemini key:

Show your Advanced Custom Fields on a slide choosing which fields appear, picking a display preset, and using a field for the slide image, title, description or button:

Build each slide out of real Gutenberg blocks headings, images, buttons, columns, anything in your editor instead of a fixed title, image and button:

Key Features – Free Version

  • Shortcode & Gutenberg Block: Use sliders in the block editor or anywhere via shortcode.
  • Unlimited Slides: Add, duplicate or remove slides in a click.
  • Gutenberg Blocks Source: Build slides from real WordPress blocks.
  • Layer Animations: Entry animations with preset delays.
  • Loop Animations: Pulse and Bounce.
  • Hover & Click Actions: Grow, lift or fade on hover; link, scroll or change slide on click.
  • Visual Timeline: Edit every layer’s delay in one place.
  • Layer Typography: Font, size, weight and spacing, Google Fonts included.
  • Responsive Layers: Hide per device, or skip the animation.
  • Slide Styling: Background, overlay, border, radius, padding and alignment per slide.
  • Auto Word-Wrap: Long links break to fit.
  • Carousel Layout: Looping autoplay, horizontal or vertical.
  • Grid Layout: Column and row gaps, items per page, Load More pagination.
  • Thumbnails Layout: Thumbnail navigation with overlay, autoplay and borders.
  • Custom Slider Height: Any height you need.
  • Slide Animations: Fade, slide and flip.
  • Autoplay & Hover Pause: Per-slide duration, pause on hover.
  • Navigation Arrows: Size, width, height, border, radius and colour.
  • Slide Indicators: Several styles, positions and directions.
  • Carousel Enhancements: Toggle arrows and indicators in one click.
  • Overlay Colors: Contrast behind text.
  • Content Positioning & Styles: Placement and typography for titles and descriptions.
  • Slide Content Panel: Show or hide title, description and button; set the label.
  • Content on Hover: Reveal chosen parts only on hover.
  • Content Background: Full tint, fade behind text, or none.
  • Picture Hover Effects: Zoom in, zoom out or grey until hover.
  • Linked Slide Pictures: The whole picture links, with a new-tab switch.
  • Post Slider Options: Category/tag query, excerpts, content length, per page, sorting and offset.
  • Default Post Types: Posts, Pages and WooCommerce Products.
  • WooCommerce Slider: Product sliders with excerpt controls.
  • ACF Fields on Slides: Three fields per slide, six display presets, or map a field to image, title, description or button.
  • Post Badges: Date and author, each with icon and placement.
  • WooCommerce Badges: Price, sale price, “Sale!” or discount percentage.
  • Badge Animation & Styling: Cascading effects, shared typography and colours.
  • Video Slider: Popup playback, big play button, autoplay, loop, mute, restart.
  • Player Controls: Play/Pause, Mute, Rewind, Fast-Forward, progress, time and duration.
  • Image Lightbox: Open pictures full size as one gallery, with swipe and pinch-to-zoom, on every layout.
  • Lightbox Caption: Caption or title, with colour, background, margin, alignment and full typography.
  • Lightbox Toolbar: Counter, thumbnails, zoom, slideshow, fullscreen, rotate, flip and download.
  • Lightbox Backdrop: Colour and opacity.

bSlider Pro – Unlock Premium Features

bSlider Pro adds advanced effects, layouts and interactions.

What’s New in the Pro Version?

  • Social & External Feeds: YouTube, Instagram, RSS or any JSON endpoint, cached.
  • Feed Presets: Channel grid, player grid, theater, reels, card and hover-overlay.
  • Profile Header Card: Name, picture, followers and Follow button.
  • Mini Player: Video docks into a corner while scrolling.
  • Hover Preview: Videos preview on hover.
  • YouTube Feed Controls: Search, playlist and privacy filters, grouping, thumbnail quality.
  • Player Options: Theme, progress colour and lazy loading.
  • Dynamic Content: Bind posts or products to slides with Post Field blocks, per block, convertible to core blocks.
  • Carousel for Block Slides: Two or three slides side by side, with Swiper effects.
  • Lottie Animation Layer: Play a Lottie JSON as the slide arrives.
  • Exit Animations: Animate layers out, not only in.
  • Fine-tuned Timing: Exact delay and duration per layer.
  • Advanced Loop Animations: Float, Flash, Shake and Swing.
  • Word by Word Animation: Headings and paragraphs, one word at a time.
  • Badge a Word: Style one word inside a sentence.
  • Hover Colour: Text and background colour on hover.
  • ACF Query: Sort and filter by any custom field, with rules that fit each field.
  • Unlimited ACF Fields: As many per slide as you need.
  • Custom Post Type Sliders: Any registered CPT.
  • Include/Exclude Items: Pick posts and products, or hide the current post.
  • List Layout: With its own styling panel.
  • Advanced Carousel Styles: Ticker, grid and 3D.
  • Slider Transition Effects: Professional effects between slides.
  • Dual Slide Direction: Horizontal or vertical.
  • Mouse Wheel & Drag: Slide by scroll or drag, with grab cursor.
  • Arrow Follow Mouse: Arrows follow the cursor.
  • Thumbnail Controls: Direction, arrows, position, size, borders and overlays.
  • Box Model & Typography: Margin, padding, borders, radius and fonts everywhere.
  • Interactive Color States: Normal and hover colours.
  • Animation Timing: Duration and start delay.
  • CTA Buttons: Custom labels and URLs, open in a new tab.
  • Icon Library: Font Awesome, Bootstrap or Lucide icons for badges and fields.
  • Custom HTML Tags: h1–h6 wrappers for SEO.
  • Inner Gap & Pagination Position: Spacing between items and grid pagination alignment.
  • Lazy Load: Defer offscreen images.
  • Advanced Video Tools: PIP, AirPlay, Download, Fullscreen, reset on end, auto-hide controls.
  • Lightbox Glass Effect: Frosted caption and backdrop.
  • Lightbox Button Styling: Colour, size, radius and spacing, gradients included.
  • Custom Lightbox Caption: Per-slide caption text.
  • Lightbox Image per Device: Lighter files on phones.
  • Per-Slide Lightbox Control: Choose which pictures open a lightbox.
  • Lightbox Size and Loop: Max size and gallery wrap.

Upgrade to Pro to unlock all premium features.

Getting Started

Add the bSlider block, choose a source and layout, then publish — or paste the generated shortcode anywhere.

Live Demo | Try Pro | Tutorials

Source Code

BSlider on GitHub

External Services

This plugin contacts outside services only while you use the feature that needs them.

AI service you set up in WordPress (Create with AI)

When you click Create in “Create with AI”, the request goes through the AI built into WordPress 7.0+ to the service you chose under Settings → Connectors. The plugin holds no AI key.

  • Sent: your slider description, the slide count and the plugin’s writing instructions. No post, user or visitor data.
  • Terms and privacy: those of your connected AI service (e.g. Google, OpenAI, Anthropic).

bPlugins Template Library

Used only while you browse or import templates in the editor, from your server, not visitors’ browsers.

  • Sent: template type, category, page, search words and plugin name (WordPress adds your site address). No post, user or visitor data. Import downloads the template’s images into your Media Library.
  • Endpoint: https://templates.bplugins.com/wp-json/gutenberg-templates/v1/
  • Terms: https://bplugins.com/terms-of-service/ — Privacy: https://bplugins.com/privacy-policy/

Third-Party Libraries

This plugin bundles the following libraries.

  • Bootstrap (MIT): carousel, grid and UI components. https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap
  • Plyr (MIT): video player for video slides. https://github.com/sampotts/plyr
  • LazyLoad (MIT): lazy loading of slide images. https://github.com/verlok/vanilla-lazyload
  • Swiper (MIT): the Carousel, Grid and Thumbnails layouts and their transitions. https://github.com/nolimits4web/swiper
  • animate.css (MIT): entry and loop animations on slide content and layers. https://github.com/animate-css/animate.css
  • Font Awesome (SIL OFL 1.1 fonts, MIT CSS): icons for arrows and UI. https://fontawesome.com/license/free
  • bpl-tools (GPL-2.0-or-later): dashboard components and shared editor controls. It may contact bPlugins, WordPress.org and Freemius for product data and checkout; details at https://github.com/bPlugins/bpl-tools#external-requests–why-they-are-made

Freemius Lite SDK

  • Source: https://bplugins.com/
  • GitHub: https://github.com/bPlugins/freemius-lite-sdk
  • License: GPL-2.0-or-later – https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-2.0.html
  • Purpose: Provides an opt-in consent form for usage tracking and analytics to help improve the plugin. No data is sent before explicit user consent.
  • External Services: Communicates with api.bplugins.com (activation events) and wp.freemius.com (opt-in processing) only after user opt-in. See bPlugins Privacy Policy and Freemius Privacy Policy.

sections.installation:
From Gutenberg Editor:

  1. Go to the WordPress Block/Gutenberg Editor
  2. Search For b-Slider Block
  3. Click on the b-Slider Block to add the block

Download & Upload:

  1. Download the b-Slider plugin (.zip file)
  2. In your admin area, go to the Plugins menu and click on Add New
  3. Click on Upload Plugin and choose the b-slider.zip file and click on Install Now
  4. Activate the plugin and Enjoy!

Manually:

  1. Download and upload the b-Slider Block plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress

Watch: your first slider in 2 minutes

Recorded with bSlider Pro, so a few options in it, such as the AI features, are Pro only.
sections.faq:
Is Slider Block free?

Yes, Slider Block is a free Gutenberg block plugin.

Does it work with any WordPress theme?

Yes, it will work with any standard WordPress theme.

Can I change block settings?

Yes, you can change block settings from the Gutenberg block editor’s right sidebar.

How many times can I reuse a block?

You can use unlimited times as you want.

Do I need Advanced Custom Fields to use bSlider?

No. ACF is optional. Install and activate Advanced Custom Fields only if you want to show your own custom fields on a slide. The ACF Integration panel appears once you have a field group whose location rules target the post type your slider is querying.

How many ACF fields can I show on a slide?

As many as you like — there is no limit on how many fields a slide can show. Fields you assign to the slide image, title, description, or button under Use ACF For are a separate setting and are shown on top of the ones you pick.

How do I get a YouTube API key or an Instagram access token?

These are only needed for the Social & External Feeds source, which is a
Pro feature. Both credentials are made outside
WordPress, so there is a video for each.

  • Creating a YouTube Data API key
  • Getting an Instagram Access Token
  • Getting YouTube OAuth access, for private and unlisted videos

In Pro each of these is also linked inside the plugin, beside the field that asks for it.

Are there video tutorials?

Short walkthroughs of what the plugin can do. The first group covers this free version and is linked
from inside the plugin, at the point each one is about. The rest cover the Social & External Feeds
source, which is a Pro feature — they are here so
you can see how it works before deciding.

Works in this free version

  • Getting started: your first slider in 2 minutes (shown with bSlider Pro)
  • Building slides out of Gutenberg blocks
  • Slide content, post badges and WooCommerce badges
  • Setting up the lightbox
  • Importing a ready-made slider from the Template Library

Pro only — Social & External Feeds

  • Getting YouTube access for private and unlisted videos
  • Creating a YouTube Data API key
  • Social feeds from start to finish
  • Mapping a JSON feed onto slides
  • Getting an Instagram Access Token

Pro only — Style with AI

  • Styling a slider and writing slide text with AI

Watch the whole playlist

Where can I get support?

You can post your questions on the support forum here

Where do I report security bugs found in this plugin?

Please report security bugs found in the source code of the bSlider plugin through the Patchstack Vulnerability Disclosure Program. The Patchstack team will assist you with verification, CVE assignment, and notify the developers of this plugin.

2.3.0 – 19 November, 2026

  • Security: Users without the unfiltered_html capability (such as Contributors and Authors) can no longer add HTML that the slider script runs. Clear your page cache after updating.

  • New: Post Types captions below or beside the picture, Video slide captions and Cover Video controls.
  • Improvement: Ken Burns zoom, arrow hover colours, all arrow styles and the mouse wheel no longer need Pro. The mouse wheel works in Firefox.
  • Fix: Vertical Align slides overlapping, Post Query panel with no categories, layer stacking, Google Fonts in the editor, and “Attempt Block Recovery” on layers with Pro settings.

BSlider on GitHub

External Services

This plugin contacts outside services only while you use the feature that needs them.

AI service you set up in WordPress (Create with AI)

When you click Create in “Create with AI”, the request goes through the AI built into WordPress 7.0+ to the service you chose under Settings → Connectors. The plugin holds no AI key.

  • Sent: your slider description, the slide count and the plugin’s writing instructions. No post, user or visitor data.
  • Terms and privacy: those of your connected AI service (e.g. Google, OpenAI, Anthropic).

bPlugins Template Library

Used only while you browse or import templates in the editor, from your server, not visitors’ browsers.

  • Sent: template type, category, page, search words and plugin name (WordPress adds your site address). No post, user or visitor data. Import downloads the template’s images into your Media Library.
  • Endpoint: https://templates.bplugins.com/wp-json/gutenberg-templates/v1/
  • Terms: https://bplugins.com/terms-of-service/ — Privacy: https://bplugins.com/privacy-policy/

Third-Party Libraries

This plugin bundles the following libraries.

  • Bootstrap (MIT): carousel, grid and UI components. https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap
  • Plyr (MIT): video player for video slides. https://github.com/sampotts/plyr
  • LazyLoad (MIT): lazy loading of slide images. https://github.com/verlok/vanilla-lazyload
  • Swiper (MIT): the Carousel, Grid and Thumbnails layouts and their transitions. https://github.com/nolimits4web/swiper
  • animate.css (MIT): entry and loop animations on slide content and layers. https://github.com/animate-css/animate.css
  • Font Awesome (SIL OFL 1.1 fonts, MIT CSS): icons for arrows and UI. https://fontawesome.com/license/free
  • bpl-tools (GPL-2.0-or-later): dashboard components and shared editor controls. It may contact bPlugins, WordPress.org and Freemius for product data and checkout; details at https://github.com/bPlugins/bpl-tools#external-requests–why-they-are-made

Freemius Lite SDK

  • Source: https://bplugins.com/
  • GitHub: https://github.com/bPlugins/freemius-lite-sdk
  • License: GPL-2.0-or-later – https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-2.0.html
  • Purpose: Provides an opt-in consent form for usage tracking and analytics to help improve the plugin. No data is sent before explicit user consent.
  • External Services: Communicates with api.bplugins.com (activation events) and wp.freemius.com (opt-in processing) only after user opt-in. See bPlugins Privacy Policy and Freemius Privacy Policy.
